summary: End-to-end verification of the STUDENT10 student discount feature (backend + frontend). All 6 acceptance criteria passing. Backend: added TestPromo class (7 tests) — GET /api/promo/{code} returns valid=true/discount_pct=0.10/label for STUDENT10 and student10 (case-insensitive), valid=false for INVALID; POST /api/bookings with promo_code STUDENT10 stores promo_code='STUDENT10' & promo_discount_pct=0.10, lowercase 'student10' is normalized to uppercase, invalid promo yields promo_code=null / promo_discount_pct=0.0, missing promo behaves the same. All 7 TestPromo tests pass (2.81s). Frontend Playwright (desktop 1280): (1) homepage renders [data-testid=student-discount-widget] showing 'STUDENT10' in [data-testid=student-code]; [data-testid=student-copy-code] and [data-testid=student-apply-btn] both work, Apply writes localStorage['mwv_promo']='STUDENT10' and scrolls to booking wizard. (2) Booking wizard on /book with mwv_promo preset was stepped from step 0→5 (Contact); [data-testid=wizard-promo] is PRE-FILLED with 'STUDENT10', [data-testid=wizard-promo-valid] shows 'Student 10% off applied — 10% off your total'; live price block shows original £180 struck-through, [data-testid=wizard-discount]='− £18.00 (Student 10% off)' and [data-testid=wizard-total]='£162.00' (exactly 90% of £180). Also verified at Van step 4: £135 → £121.50 with matching struck-through. (3) Typing 'BADCODE' shows [data-testid=wizard-promo-invalid] hint and removes the wizard-discount node; re-typing 'student10' re-shows the valid message (case-insensitive input on client). (4) MyJobs (/jobs) as a logged-in customer with a STUDENT10 booking: [data-testid=promo-applied-banner] shows 'STUDENT10 10% student discount applied — prices below already include it.'; the seeded approved-driver offer card shows original £135.00 struck through with new price £121.50, and Accept button reads 'Accept — £18.23' (=15% deposit of the discounted £121.50). Payment path (Square modal) was intentionally NOT executed per the do-not-charge instruction.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py validate_promo() returns HTTP 200 with {valid:false} for unknown codes — semantically fine and matches spec, but consider a distinct 404 status for programmatic clients; current behaviour is intentional per spec so this is informational only.

BookingWizard.jsx line 266 uppercases the input on change AND calls savePromo(v) only when getPromo(v) is truthy — good; however typing then deleting the code does NOT clear localStorage. If a user removes the code manually, mwv_promo persists and a fresh /book visit will re-pre-fill it. Consider clearing localStorage when the field is emptied, or exposing a 'remove student discount' affordance.

MyJobs OfferList: Accept button label computes deposit off discounted price (`(payType==='deposit' ? o.price*0.15 : o.price) * (1-promoPct)`). Backend /select-driver applies discount to the base price server-side (see server.py L744-763), so payment amount matches. Verified for deposit path (UI showed £18.23 = 0.15 * 0.9 * 135).

success_rate.frontend: 100% (widget + wizard pre-fill + wizard invalid + MyJobs banner + discounted offer + discounted accept)
